question.text: In a Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP) where the issue size is GREATER THAN Rs. 250 crore, what is the minimum number of allottees required under SEBI ICDR?

explanation.text: The Logic: NISM-Series-IX Merchant Banking workbook pp. 173-174 state that for a QIP with issue size GREATER THAN Rs. 250 crore, the minimum number of allottees is 5. (For issue size up to Rs. 250 crore, the minimum is 2.) With the issue size now specified as more than Rs. 250 crore, the uniquely correct figure is 5. The Trap: Option A (2) is the minimum that applies when the issue size is Rs. 250 crore or less, which is why the original (size-agnostic) stem could be defended for either 2 or 5. Option C (3) is the minimum number of QIB mutual funds / AIF Cat I-II that must be among the allottees when the QIP is offered to MFs/AIFs, not the total minimum allottees. Option B (10) has no source basis. Note: The original stem omitted the QIP issue size, so both the 2-allottee minimum (size <= Rs. 250 crore) and the 5-allottee minimum (size > Rs. 250 crore) were defensible from the same workbook pages. The stem now explicitly fixes issue size > Rs. 250 crore, making option D (5) the uniquely correct answer (NISM-Series-IX workbook pp. 173-174).
